terms.title: Terms of use
sections: About this test marketplace

Lebse connects people buying and selling pre-owned fashion. This build is a local test environment. Payments, refunds and courier events are simulated. No sale, insurance cover, courier booking or money transfer is arranged with an external provider through this build. These draft rules describe permitted testing and the intended marketplace safeguards; the identified operator and final commercial terms must be supplied before launch.
Your account

You must be at least 18 to register in this pilot. Supply accurate information, keep your credentials private and use only accounts you are entitled to access. You may buy and sell, but may not buy your own listing, impersonate another person, manipulate reviews, evade a restriction or use the service for fraudulent activity. Tell support if you suspect account misuse. Age confirmation is self-declared and is not identity verification.
Seller responsibilities

List only fashion items you own and are legally entitled to sell. Describe the item, price, condition and flaws accurately. Use photographs you own or have permission to use. Counterfeit, stolen, unsafe or unlawful goods, weapons, drugs, recalled items and services unrelated to fashion are prohibited. Lebse may hold or remove a listing for review. A listing or account being visible does not mean it has been authenticated or endorsed.
Offers, checkout and delivery

An offer is open for 24 hours unless withdrawn, declined, superseded or expired earlier. An accepted offer reserves the piece for 30 minutes; a direct purchase reserves it for 15 minutes. Checkout shows the item and delivery total before a test payment is submitted. Do not send payment, verification codes or passwords through chat. Sellers should mark items ready only after confirmed payment. A courier integration, if enabled in a future release, will receive only the collection and delivery details necessary to perform the delivery. Any future provider-specific terms and costs must be disclosed before booking.
Cancellations, problems and refunds

Use the order controls for an eligible cancellation. After pickup, or if an item is missing, damaged, counterfeit or materially different from its listing, report a problem from the order. A report creates a review request and may hold further processing; it is not an automatic refund decision. In this test build refunds are ledger labels only. Before launch, final return rights, timelines, fees and refund processes must be reviewed and published. Nothing here removes a right or remedy that applicable law makes mandatory.
Safety decisions and appeals

Lebse uses transaction amounts, recent activity, failed payment attempts and reports to identify activity needing review. A hold is a precaution and is not a finding of fraud. You can submit an appeal through Safety & privacy. Authorized reviewers should record reasons, examine evidence and correct mistakes. Do not file knowingly false or abusive reports.
Content and intellectual property

You retain rights in the content you provide. You grant the operator a non-exclusive permission to store, display and process that content only as reasonably necessary to operate the marketplace, support orders and handle complaints, subject to the privacy notice and applicable law. You confirm you have the required rights. Report suspected infringement through the copyright report option, identifying the work, listing, your contact and the basis for the claim. Rights in third-party brands, images and software remain with their owners.
Limits, changes and applicable law

No term promises that fraud will always be detected or that delivery will always succeed. These terms do not exclude liability or statutory obligations that cannot lawfully be excluded. Final governing-law, dispute-resolution and any permissible liability provisions require Ethiopian counsel and confirmation of the operating entity and launch markets. Material terms updates will require a new explicit acceptance. You can stop using the service and submit an account or data request without accepting optional data uses.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
sections: Who is responsible

This is a draft notice for Lebse’s local test build. The legal operator, registered address, privacy contact, service providers and launch jurisdictions have not yet been finalized. Do not submit government ID documents, payment card details or sensitive personal information in this build.
What this build stores

Account names, usernames, email identifiers, salted password hashes, session records, listings and uploaded photographs, saves, follows, messages, offers, orders, delivery details, reviews, notifications, consent choices, terms acceptance, support requests and rule-based security review records are stored locally on the computer running the server. Security rate limits use a hash of the connection address and the relevant account identifier where needed. Raw passwords and browser session secrets are not put into audit logs.
Why data is used

Account and transaction data support the service you request. Security records help prevent abuse, protect accounts, investigate reports and keep an audit trail. Optional external photographs are loaded only after your choice permits them. Optional choices are separate from agreement to the terms. The applicable lawful bases, processor contracts, international transfers and registration obligations must be confirmed before a public launch.
Visibility and sharing

Public listings, listing images, usernames and seller reviews can be seen by other visitors. Messages and orders are limited to their participants; delivery addresses are not shown in public closets or listing cards. Authorized local operators can investigate review cases. Uploaded listing photos referenced by historical orders may remain publicly accessible by their URL after a listing is archived; do not include private documents or addresses in photos. External sample photographs use Unsplash when enabled. Real payment, identity-verification and courier providers are not connected. Any later sharing with such providers requires a reviewed notice, agreement, security controls and data minimization.
Your choices and requests

Cookie settings let you reject optional uses or withdraw your choice. You can submit an access, correction, deletion, account-closure or appeal request through Safety & privacy. Requests are saved for an operator to review; submission does not instantly erase transaction records, evidence, backups or another participant’s messages. The operator must verify requests and retain only what is required for a documented purpose or legal obligation. No fixed statutory response time is claimed by this draft.
Retention and security

Local test data persists until an authorized operator manages it. Automatic retention, backup deletion and a production erasure workflow are not yet implemented. Rate-limit buckets are cleaned after expiry. Session records expire and can be revoked. Before launch, approve category-specific retention periods, secure backups, access reviews and a tested incident-response process. This notice is not a claim of completed regulatory compliance.

cookies.title: Cookies and storage
sections: Essential storage

lebse_session is an HttpOnly sign-in cookie that lasts up to 12 hours. It is used to authenticate requests, not for advertising. lebse_consent is an HttpOnly preference receipt lasting up to 180 days and is created when you save a choice. It remembers that choice and links to a server-side consent record. Security checks operate even when optional uses are rejected. A temporary navigation-return value may be stored in sessionStorage to return you to your chosen screen after sign-in.
Optional external photographs

External sample fashion photographs are disabled by default. If you enable them, your browser connects to images.unsplash.com to request the images; that provider receives connection information such as your IP address. Lebse suppresses the page referrer. Locally uploaded product photographs continue to work without this optional setting. Withdrawing permission removes the external images from the page and prevents new image requests; it cannot undo requests already sent or erase a third party’s records.
Analytics and advertising

No analytics or advertising SDK is installed or activated in this build. Enabling photographs does not give consent to analytics or advertising. A future integration must add its own explained category, remain off until consent, and stop when consent is withdrawn. Google Fonts loading has been removed from this build.
Changing your choice

Choose Reject optional, Allow external photos, or Cookie settings. Rejecting is as accessible as allowing, and does not prevent browsing, sign-in or transactions. Open Cookie settings in the footer at any time. We record the preference version, choice, source and time. A new version or expired receipt prompts a new choice.

copyright.title: Copyright and reporting
sections: Rights notice

© 2026 Lebse. Rights in original Lebse branding and application content are reserved by their respective rights holders. This notice does not assert ownership of seller photographs, third-party brands, sample photography or open-source dependencies. Seller content remains the seller’s or its rights holder’s property. Ownership and trademark clearance for the Lebse name must be confirmed before launch.
Report a concern

Use Report a concern → Copyright, and include the listing reference, the work concerned, your relationship to the rights holder, a contact method and an explanation of the alleged infringement. Avoid uploading identity documents or unrelated personal data. The operator will need a documented review, response and appeal process before launch; this draft does not promise a particular jurisdiction’s safe-harbor protection.
